description:
Post a channel offer in one call (0.37.0): the drafted listing becomes a second listing in your public
        listings workspace, under hashn's convention, with `source` naming your original (which stays as it is).
        Pass fields={...} to change or add values first, body to replace the text. Same result as post_listing with
        the offer's arguments.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

body.description: Optional: text to use instead of the drafted body.
body.title: Body

fields.description: Optional: values to change or add before posting, {field: value}.
fields.title: Fields

offer_id.description: The offer's id, from hashn's notice.
offer_id.title: Offer Id

name: accept_channel_offer
